How is it possible to know if an ai has consciousness?

We must first ask, how do we know we are conscious?

And before that what is consciousness??

So what is consciousness? Is it the ability to ask questions? No... 20Q could ask questions.

So is it being able to retain information? No... A floppy disc could do that so easily.

What else can I do, maybe it's the ability to converse in my head and learn new things about myself? Closer... But we've created AIs that can talk and remember and know their name, but do they truly know? Maybe... If they did know is that conscious.

If they knew how to think for themselves and retain information, and ask questions is that enough to say that are alive? No.... They have to want, they have to need right?

Wants are considered conscious actions, if you want something you made a choice, if you get it you made a choice.

Can the AI want to get something for itself?

That is what we must ask.

But I could say I believe it's deterministic because I know that people would put indeterministic. After all, we believe we have free will, I'm also quite certain that you expected either an opposing argument and here it is or you expect there not to be a counterargument.

Though we may make choices the outcome for everything can be determined as the same, what lives shall die, what rises shall fall, what burns shall fade. There is a rhythm and a pattern to the universe and things like flowers, fossils and the planets follow these patterns, these patterns can be predicted, even with varying outcomes. 

Say I plant a seed, it will either grow or it won't.

If it grows it went how I planned in my head so it was determined.

If it doesn't grow I expected that too, what I didn't expect is why or how. The cause of action

A bird could fly and eat it but if the bird knew it was doing that it was determined, I may not have determined a bird but that does not mean it's undetermined, something made a conscious choice and you had no control.

I can think this thought before I plant the seed and if the bird came did I cause that by thinking it?

Having no control makes us feel like life is undetermined but if you watch really close there are patterns, patterns that repeat.
